title: Sand.ai Announces Completion of $200 Million Series A+ Funding Round, with Multiple Investors and Shanghai State-Owned Capital Strongly Increasing Their Investments

content_html:
According to the latest news from Sand.ai, the frontier company focused on video large-model R&D has officially announced the completion of an A+ funding round totaling as much as $200 million. As a highly watched new-generation force in the current large-model sector, the smooth closing of this exceptionally large financing round signals the market's firm confidence in the commercial prospects of video generation technology.

Top capital from multiple parties gathers, existing shareholders continue to increase their bets

In this financing round, the investor lineup can be described as star-studded, bringing together important forces including industrial capital, well-known RMB and USD funds, and Shanghai state-owned capital.

Specifically, this round was co-led by Cornerstone Capital and Wangsu Science & Technology; a group of well-known institutions, including Times Capital, Panlin Capital, and Orient Securities Capital, participated as followers; Tianchuang Capital joined as a strategic investor together with Shandong Railway Investment Industrial Investment and Shandong Railway Fund; at the same time, institutions with Shanghai state-owned capital backgrounds, such as Pudong Venture Capital and Shanghai Guofang, also all entered the round. In addition, several existing shareholders, including Matrix Partners China, Huaye Tiancheng, and CAS Star, chose to continue increasing their investment, demonstrating a high degree of recognition of the company's long-term development.

With the smooth injection of these funds, Sand.ai will further accelerate its underlying technology R&D in the field of video large models, the construction of computing infrastructure, and the comprehensive layout of its commercialization ecosystem.
